With legacy semantics and `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, a model can be built over only a subset of `n.snapshots`. `solve_model` passes the full `n.snapshots` to `_call_extra_functionality`, and `_as_model_snapshots` returns it unchanged for a non-flat model, so the callback receives snapshots beyond those the model was built over.
